lines: 「Fuuma-kun, I'll leave the directions to you!」
Mud golems were approaching from the front,
What was more, the ground was muddy, so it was hard to move quickly.
This was the place to stop our feet and confront the enemy.
「Nao-senpai, you take the mud golems, Koro-senpai the will-o'-the-wisps. Make sure not to let the enemies get close.」
「Hebiko, you and I hit the ones that come through the middle.」
Nao-senpai and Koro-senpai turned their backs to each other, sandwiching Hebiko and I right in the middle.
Koro-senpai's invisible instant-draw slash technique was unleashed, and Nao-senpai's floating kunai fired lasers.
The mud golems and will-o'-the-wisps were brought down as soon as they tried to approach us.
There was no need for Hebiko or I to do anything.
However, no matter if they were defeated and defeated, those things would keep coming back to life.
「It's all within my calculations! Even the Stray Blade Style is tough if your feet are caught, right?」
「And Homare's ninja arts may have been the most troublesome, but their power gets a whole lot weaker once the sun sets, doesn't it? Mmm?」
「Seriously annoying. Koro-chan, let's do it now.」
「My power gets weaker once the sun sets, you say? Do you think I'm stupid? I at least know the nature of my own arts!」
Nao-senpai readied her “Baldr” laser rifle, which she hadn't used until now.
「This thing can also store light energy.」
All of the kunai balls were ejected from her Taimanin suit at once, and surrounded us.
Numazu hurriedly covered his entire body with mud.
Like a shotgun, scattered lasers were fired from the mouth of Baldr.

They were absorbed by the floating kunai balls, then scattered even more minutely, becoming a shower of lasers, and raining down on the surrounding mud golems, will-o'-the-wisps, and Numazu all at once.
The mud golems and will-o'-the-wisps that were surrounding us were all annihilated instantly.
The laser shower rained down relentlessly on Numazu, who had guarded his entire body with mud.
However, after the lights had died down, and he had shed his battered, lumpy mud armour, what appeared was his body, almost unharmed.
「Guhahahahahahahahahahaha!!! Was that a final, desperate resort?! You're amusing me, ya know?!!」
Because their energy had been diffused, their power had weakened, and it looked like they hadn't been able to inflict damage to the body beneath the thick mud.
「How long's that measly battery gonna last? Eh?」
「And, these guys can keep coming out limitlessly!!」
The mud golems and will-o'-the-wisps that we had just defeated were regenerating in a flash―――Probably.
「Oi?! Fuuma brat! What are you planning?!」
「No, I don't mean to do that at all......」
「Then why're you covering your eyes?! Why are you being blindfolded with Shishimura's hands?!」
As Numazu pointed out, a little earlier, Koro-senpai had gone behind my back, and was covering my eyes with both hands, like we were playing the “Who's there?” game.
「What are you talking about?! No, wait?! Where'd the octopus woman go?!」
It looked like he had finally realized.
She had been missing from the moment that Numazu had covered his entire body in mud, just before the laser shower.
「You showed off your own ninja arts too much, old man.」
「I predicted that you would trap us in a swamp.」
「So we already discussed how to deal with it.」
「Stop bein' a sore loser, kid!!! Once you're stuck in my swamp, you can't get out!」
「Not with “human legs”. But that won't work on octopus legs.」
Hebiko's octopus legs were like snakes, so to speak.
In contrast to human legs, their weight wasn't concentrated on a single point, so, like snakes, it was possible for them to move freely even over mud.
「Where's the octopus woman?! Where'd she run off to?! Why's that brat got his eyes covered?!」
Perhaps because he was weak to unexpected developments, Numazu was surprisingly shaken.
「Don't you know about the octopus's secret ability? They can camouflage.」
「They alter the patterns on their skin to blend in with the surrounding terrain.」
「When they want to use 100% of their ability, they, um...... have to undress, though.」
A naked girl—no, octopus girl—showed herself in front of Numazu.
I couldn't see it, but that was probably the case.

Hebiko's Four-Blade Style had cut Numazu's body to shreds.
―――Well, probably.
「I-Is he all right...? Hebiko slashed him pretty seriously......」
Naturally, she had already put her clothes on.
I was also freed from my blindfold.
「It's all right. Mud users are built sturdy. Old man, quit playing dead and get up.」
「Mud users can nullify enemy attacks by turning their bodies into mud. Right, old man?」
「Ah, right, right, I remember. When they've turned their whole bodies to mud, they become almost invincible, but there's just one spot they can't transform.」
「Shall I stab you there as a test? If you really are dead, it won't matter, but if you're playing dead, that'll end you.」
「Your heart's your weak spot, right? That's the only place you can't turn into mud.」
「（If you make any funny moves, I'll stab you through the heart.）」
「You really are well-versed in ninja art knowledge, aren't you, Fuuma-kun?」
「Thanks. Now, we're going to have you tell us everything you know, all right?」
Numazu's face, which had been spitting venom at me, suddenly changed.
「P-Please forgive me......... This isn't what it looks like......!!!」
His face turned pale, and he had gone into a panic.
There wasn't a trace of the arrogant attitude from a moment earlier.
「I-I deeply apologize!!! I didn't mean to get in your......!!」
There was no way he was frightened by me.
Who was he conversing with?! What was he seeing?
「Oi, old man?! Who are you talking to?!」
All of a sudden, Numazu's right arm exploded at the joint.
Furthermore, his body then disappeared into the residence like it was being pulled by something invisible.
We stormed into the estate a little behind Numazu.
The moment he was about to speak further, with a terrified face,
The area that contained his heart, the sole weak point that he couldn't turn into mud, blew apart.
His remaining parts melted into sludge, and spread across the floor.
「Shit! We've been tricked!! The enemy's here!」
We hadn't been able to get anything out of him.
Furthermore, whoever had killed Numazu was here.
And we were their next targets.
Thinking that, we prepared for an attack, but even after three minutes passed, then five, nothing happened.
「It looks like the enemy ran away, huh?」
「Maybe it would be more accurate to say, they didn't feel like fighting us now.」
Though the reason was unclear, it looked like whoever had killed Numazu had gone.
And there was no doubt that that person was the serial killer.
「The killer certainly did appear before us.」
「Yeah, but I couldn't tell what kind of ninja art that was whatsoever......」
「It's not like you don't know of any ninja arts that blow people up, right?」
「I could hypothesize a lot of things there.」
「But considering that we weren't able to see them right to the end, and that they pulled Numazu into the mansion......」
「So you can't tell at all right now. It's risky to judge based on insufficient information, right?」
「Yes. As of yet, I can't identity those ninja arts at all.」
Koro-senpai pointed at a long, narrow wrapped package that was near Numazu, who no longer retained his basic shape.
It was a brand-new package, a mismatch for this dilapidated house.
「That means it's a new message, huh?」
Indeed, what appeared from inside was a severed human leg.
It was a frozen left leg, and probably a woman's, going by the shape.
Was this the left leg of the second-year Asai Miori?
The demeanour of our two senpais was strange.
They were shaken by more than the fact that there was a woman's severed left leg there.
With a grave expression, Koro-senpai used her Soul Escape Arts to perform “Underworld Record” on the leg.
As a result of that, an answer came back to us that was completely different from my expectations.
Her voice, which was quiet enough already, was now on the verge of disappearing.
「Tsuru-chan was a close friend of ours.」
Nao-senpai's face had stiffened as well.
「She was someone you're also indirectly connected to.」
「Izumo Tsuru. Before she started going by her mother's name, she was Sagou Tsuru.」
「Tsuru-chan was recorded as having died when Nisha Gaiza's rebellion happened.」
「That was because at the time of the revolt, only her right leg had been found.」
「In other words, she's Library's—No, Sagou Bungo's―――」
